svg.title: Sands of Time — Dominion of Hours. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Sand classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Borrowed Hours forks into Quickened Sands then Sovereign of the Hour, or Brittle with Age then The Inevitable Hour. Suspended Moment forks into Held in Stasis then Timeless Bastion, or Leaden Seconds then Stilled Hourglass. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Sand jutsu.

Timeshift adds a second, broad 35% exposure row and Cellular Regeneration a static Heal 25 (250 HP per tick). The tree follows those pairs: an offensive Foundation on Momentum Shift (strike harder myself or age the target) and a defensive Foundation on Timelapse (shelter myself or weaken them). Routes: Sustained amplification +10% Increase Damage Given on Momentum Shift's self row, Exposure +8% Increase Damage Taken, Fortress +10% Decrease Damage Taken with +5% Heal, Suppression +10% Decrease Damage Given. Damage stays unamplified (R1\u2033): the Traits are Tank and Control, not Burst, and both prongs fail: strike-led (1 of 3 offensive percentage rows sits on a strike; Timeshift's exposure does, Momentum Shift's exposure and self buff do not, as Momentum Shift has no Damage row) and finisher (Eternity Flux, the 50 row, is C-rank; Timelapse is the kit's A-rank strike). Stun, timecompression and barrier are unsupported and receive nothing."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Borrowed Hours","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"Every second stolen from them is a second lent to you.","coverage_note":"Increase Damage Taken 35 \u2192 37% on Timeshift (four stat types, no element) and Momentum Shift (Earth/None/Sand/Wind hits); Changes from Draft 4: the +5 Damage route (Grinding Sands / Erosion of Eternity; the 40s to 45, Eternity Flux 50 \u2192 55) becomes sustained amplification, Quickened Sands +3% / Sovereign of the Hour +5% Increase Damage Given (2/3/5 = +10% on Momentum Shift's one self row); The Inevitable Hour drops its Increase Damage Given rider and is pure exposure (2/2/4 = +8%); Suspended Moment trades Heal +2% for Decrease Damage Given +2%; Timeless Bastion carries the whole +5% Heal; Stilled Hourglass is +5% Decrease Damage Given (route still +10%) with +2% Decrease Damage Taken. The roster pass's +2 Damage on Sovereign is withdrawn under R1\u2033 (no Burst trait; strike-led fails, 1 of 3 offensive rows on a strike; finisher fails, Eternity Flux is C-rank and Timelapse A), so Damage is unamplified (Timeshift and Timelapse 40, Eternity Flux 50 EP in every allocation).","Sovereign vs Exposure at 3 BP, with the offensive fourth (Brittle with Age / Quickened Sands) in brackets; base kit \u00d72.46 with all three Momentum Shift / Timeshift rows live. With all three live a caster's hit takes \u00d72.72 [\u00d72.80] under Sovereign and \u00d72.80 [\u00d72.86] under Exposure; Timeshift window alone \u00d71.37 [\u00d71.39] vs \u00d71.43; Momentum Shift window alone \u00d71.99 [\u00d72.02] vs \u00d71.96 [\u00d72.00]; an ally's hit on the mark \u00d71.88 [\u00d71.93] vs \u00d72.04. Exposure is the single-target team route; Sovereign leads on the caster's hits where its self buff meets only one exposure row, and on unmarked targets (Timelapse's circle \u00d71.45 vs \u00d71.37 [\u00d71.40]). Exposure stays at the batch's two-row +8%, \u00d71.122 compounded (director question).","Defence: both routes use one Timelapse cast. An enemy in the circle hits the caster at \u00d70.408 (Fortress) or \u00d70.396 (Suppression) at 3 BP, \u00d70.39 or \u00d70.378 with the sibling Hidden Art (base \u00d70.49); the Fortress keeps its Heal, the Suppression covers every enemy in the circle and the caster's allies. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +8%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Heal +5%; no flat Damage.","Matching and delivery (tags.ts 3477\u20133510; \u00a73b): Timeshift's exposure and Timelapse's rows list four stat types and no element, so they match nearly every non-pierce hit; Momentum Shift's exposure matches only Earth/None/Sand/Wind hits; its self buff ('Highest', no element) matches the caster's highest-stat and element-less hits. Every cast has cooldown 7 and buff/debuff rows act the two rounds after the cast round only."],"risks":["Classification: Sand is the single signature element and no other captured kit carries it. 4 of 9 kit rows carry Sand; the other five need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Cellular Regeneration carries no element on any row, so in-kit it qualifies only through an authored Sand jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Sand coverage is unverified.","Ally hazard: Timelapse's Sand damage hits every other user inside the circle, allies included (friendly fire none = ALL; the caster never; actions.ts 1029-1060); the tree adds no Damage to it (40 EP). Only enemies get its Decrease Damage Given row, and the Decrease Damage Taken row is self-targeted.","Exposure reach: The Inevitable Hour's 43% rows amplify allies' hits as well as the caster's, and any other Increase Damage Taken source multiplies again (stacking on, process.ts 1109-1117). Team value is larger than the duel arithmetic above.","Area suppression reach: Stilled Hourglass's 40% Decrease Damage Given lands on every enemy in the Timelapse circle and cuts their damage to the caster's allies too; worth more in team battles than one row suggests.","Heal: static heal is \u00d710 HP per tick, so +5% Heal adds 50 HP per tick (600 per cast vs 500). The SELF row on the EMPTY_GROUND spiral lands on the caster at cast time, not through the tiles (actions.ts 980-1004), and ticks on the two following rounds only. Healprevent blocks it.","Highest-stat resolution (G16): Momentum Shift's self buff lists 'Highest', resolved from the caster's highestOffence (a required BattleUserState field, types.ts 156). If undefined, it would still match element-less hits and the kit's own Sand rows, not other elemental jutsu.","No combat simulation: stun, timecompression, the barrier, circle target counts, AP and uptime were not modelled. A sealed or prevented Timelapse cast removes both defensive routes' value for that cycle. circle"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-B (The Inevitable Hour +8% Increase Damage Taken on 2 rows: Timeshift 35 \u2192 43%; Momentum Shift 35 \u2192 43%; \u2248 \u00d71.122, against Shakunetsu Sakura \u00d71.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes \u00d71.115).","concerns":["Damage is unamplified (R1\u2033: Traits Tank, Control, no Burst; strike-led fails, 1 of 3 offensive percentage rows on a strike; finisher fails, Eternity Flux is C-rank and Timelapse A), so Sovereign of the Hour is a bare +10% on one self row (2/3/5, \u00d71.074). Shakunetsu Sakura's single-row +10% routes also carry a +5% Heal or +3% Decrease Damage Given rider; a rider here would borrow a defensive route's tag (Heal, Decrease Damage Taken or Given).","The Inevitable Hour's +8% Increase Damage Taken on two compounding, team-wide rows is \u00d71.122, just above Blood-Enchanted Eyes' exposure maximum (\u00d71.115) and above Shakunetsu Sakura's \u00d71.075. It is the kit's primary Control identity and should be ruled with the roster's other two-row exposure routes (Aerathiel, Crystal Essence, Kyuko-sei, Houkyuken, Hyouga Yui, Sea-King's Blessing and Tenohira Musei at +8%), not alone.","At 3 BP Exposure out-values Sovereign of the Hour wherever both exposure rows reach a hit (an ally's hit on the mark \u00d72.04 vs \u00d71.88; the caster's hit with all three rows live \u00d72.80 vs \u00d72.72) and on a hit that meets one exposure row without the self buff (\u00d71.43 vs \u00d71.37). Sovereign leads wherever its self buff meets only one exposure row (\u00d71.99 vs \u00d71.96: the Momentum Shift window alone, a Timeshift-marked target that Momentum Shift did not mark, or a highest-stat hit outside Earth/None/Sand/Wind on a target with all three rows live) and on unmarked targets such as Timelapse's circle (\u00d71.45 vs \u00d71.37). Party size, target count and window uptime were not simulated.","Every percentage row except Momentum Shift's exposure carries no Sand and needs the proposed jutsu-classification resolver; Sovereign of the Hour's whole route depends on it."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Sand jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Sovereign of the Hour path + Brittle with Age
The Inevitable Hour path + Suspended Moment
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SANDS OF TIME KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Sand classification / forked tree
